provenance: BetaNYC modified this data: reshaped it and cleaned it. This copy should not be considered the official record. Official record: New York City Charter, bulk XML download (American Legal Publishing), https://files.amlegal.com/pdffiles/NewYorkCity/Charter/XML.zip

BetaNYC downloads the bulk XML file from American Legal Publishing's New York City code library, the site the NYC Law Department contracted for the Charter, Administrative Code and Rules, and builds an index from it. A scheduled job refreshes the index daily and publishes a new release when the text changed. The index ships with the npm package, so this server answers without going online.

Modified by BetaNYC: The XML is split into one record per section or heading, with its citation pulled from the heading. BetaNYC also fixes text problems from the conversion: it decodes character codes the XML left as text (such as non-breaking spaces), removes American Legal Publishing's editing markers (such as [ALP S-054]) that leak into the body text, and puts back the space between a list number and the words after it. All line breaks are collapsed, so paragraphs and tables run together as one block of text. Deeper structure, such as which sections sit inside which title, is not kept.
